about: I'm a senior at Brown studying biology – but the thread through everything I do is building. I build software (a language-learning app in closed beta), hardware (an e-ink flight display for my boyfriend), and content (a recipe site preserving my mother's cooking in five languages). The biology is real too: I run data pipelines over terabytes of brain-imaging data in the Chen Lab, TA immunology for 175 students a semester, and spent two years running multinational clinical studies.

I'm natively bilingual in English and Turkish, fluent in Japanese including business keigo, and advanced in German. I move to New York in June 2027 and I'm currently recruiting for strategy and operations roles starting summer 2027 – the kind of work where figuring out how systems run, then making them run better, is the whole job.

contact.blurb: The fastest way to reach me is email – whether it's about a role, a project, or just to say hi. I'm happy to share references, transcripts, or work samples on request.
